08:45–09:05 AM · Hospital staff changing area

Women's staff changing area ke bahar ek yellow board rakha tha — CLEANING IN PROGRESS — PLEASE WAIT. Meenakshi duty schedule mein busy thi; woh board notice kiye bina andar enter kar gayi.
Meenakshi ko room khaali laga. Usne bag bench par rakha, phone silent kiya aur wristwatch utaar di. Use rounds se pehle apna milk-expression routine complete karna zaroori tha.

Partition ke doosri taraf Harish Pal (62), senior ward attendant, aur Sunil Yadav (46), housekeeping cleaner, pehle se cleaning supplies arrange kar rahe the. Meenakshi ki entry par Sunil ne dheemi awaaz mein kaha, “Harish ji, lagta hai doctor madam aa gayi hain.”

Sunil ne thodi tez awaaz mein kaha, “Madam, cleaning chal rahi hai… ek minute.” Meenakshi tak awaaz clearly nahi pahunchi. Dono workers ko apni presence announce karke turant bahar nikalna chahiye tha. Complaint ya awkward confrontation ke darr se woh hichkicha gaye, lekin unka wahan rukna privacy violation tha.

Usne private pumping kit nikali. Soft plum kurta ke buttons khole aur use side mein rakh diya. Bra ke hooks khole, bra utaar di. Uske full, heavy breasts free ho gaye. Nipples already tight aur sensitive the, milk pressure ki wajah se.

Usne pump ke flanges ko dono breasts par set kiya. Machine on ki. Soft suction shuru hua. Pehle dheere, phir steady rhythm mein. Doodh nikalna shuru hua — warm, steady stream. Har suction ke saath uske breasts thode compress ho rahe the, phir release. Woh quietly saans leti rahi, ek haath se pump adjust karti hui, doosre haath se storage bottle check karti hui.

Lagbhag 8–10 minute baad bottles fill ho gayi. Usne machine off ki, flanges carefully remove kiye. Thoda milk skin par chipak gaya tha. Usne soft wipe se clean kiya. Breasts ab halki si red aur sensitive the, nipples swollen.

Harish aur Sunil wahan maujood rahe. Woh Meenakshi ki pumping aur changing ke dauraan bhi nahi hate. Unke paas turant hatne ka mauka tha, lekin unhone uski privacy protect nahi ki. Meenakshi ko ab tak unki presence ka pata nahi tha.

Back to Meenakshi — 09:00 AM. Meenakshi ne apna routine complete kar liya tha. Usne fresh bra pehna, hospital ka professional top aur baaki clinical attire pehne, white coat uthaya. Mirror ke saamne khadi hokar hair aur ID card theek kiye.

ID card, stethoscope aur hair arrangement — sab ready the. Usne personal belongings aur pumping kit apne assigned locker mein rakhe. Locker properly close karke lock check kiya. Later unauthorized duplicate-key access ek alag incident rahega, is waqt locker secure tha.
Meenakshi ne apna ID card straighten kiya. “Perfect. Ab rounds.”

09:05 AM. Woh staff changing area se nikal kar ward ki taraf chal di. Use sirf apna routine yaad tha. Use laga wahan koi aur present nahi tha. Yellow cleaning board uske dhyaan mein nahi aaya, aur use yeh bhi pata nahi tha ki room mein Harish aur Sunil maujood the.
